code: library(msm); library(survival)  cut   <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10) lrate <- c(-2.2, -1.8, -1.5, -1.9, -2.4, -2.0, -1.7)   # log baseline per interval beta  <- 0.6 n     <- 4000  sim_simpexp <- function(dat)   sim_pexp(~ lrate[interval] + beta * x, dat, cut = cut)  sim_rpexp <- function(dat) {   tt <- vapply(dat$x, function(xi) {     r <- exp(lrate + beta * xi)     msm::rpexp(1, c(r, r[length(r)]), cut)   }, 0)   data.frame(id = dat$id, x = dat$x, tstop = pmin(tt, 10),     status = as.integer(tt <= 10)) }  B <- 10 est <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {   set.seed(1000 + b)   dat <- data.frame(id = 1:n, x = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5))   c(simpexp = coef(coxph(Surv(tstop, status) ~ x, sim_simpexp(dat))),     rpexp   = coef(coxph(Surv(tstop, status) ~ x, sim_rpexp(dat)))) }, numeric(2))  data.frame(   source   = c("simpexp", "msm::rpexp"),   estimate = rowMeans(est),   mc_se    = apply(est, 1, sd) / sqrt(B),   truth    = beta,   row.names = NULL) #>       source  estimate      mc_se truth #> 1    simpexp 0.6235827 0.01065173   0.6 #> 2 msm::rpexp 0.5870984 0.01160832   0.6 set.seed(42) dat <- data.frame(id = 1:20000, x = rbinom(20000, 1, 0.5)) a <- sim_simpexp(dat); b <- sim_rpexp(dat) suppressWarnings(ks.test(a$tstop, b$tstop)) #>  #>  Asymptotic two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test #>  #> data:  a$tstop and b$tstop #> D = 0.00705, p-value = 0.7029 #> alternative hypothesis: two-sided

Refining grid removes . covariate effect, contrast, moves within standard error (se_beta) – discretising baseline bias proportional effect, usual reason coarse grid tolerable practice. Averaged replications, two simulators agree truth :
code: library(simsurv)  lambda <- 0.08; gamma <- 1.4; beta_x <- -0.5 n <- 5000 log_h <- function(t, x) log(lambda * gamma) + (gamma - 1) * log(t) + beta_x * x  weib_fit <- function(time, status, x) {   m  <- survreg(Surv(time, status) ~ x, dist = "weibull")   sh <- 1 / m$scale   c(shape = sh, lambda = exp(-sh * coef(m)[["(Intercept)"]]),     beta = -coef(m)[["x"]] * sh, se_beta = sh * sqrt(vcov(m)["x", "x"])) }  set.seed(7) dat <- data.frame(id = 1:n, x = rnorm(n)) ss  <- simsurv(dist = "weibull", lambdas = lambda, gammas = gamma,                betas = c(x = beta_x), x = dat, maxt = 10) ss  <- merge(ss, dat, by = "id")  rows <- list(truth   = c(shape = gamma, lambda = lambda, beta = beta_x, se_beta = NA),              simsurv = weib_fit(ss$eventtime, ss$status, ss$x)) for (by in c(1, 0.25, 0.05)) {   sp <- sim_pexp(~ log_h(t, x), dat, cut = seq(0, 10, by = by))   rows[[paste0("simpexp, by = ", by)]] <- weib_fit(sp$tstop, sp$status, sp$x) } round(do.call(rbind, rows), 4) #>                     shape lambda    beta se_beta #> truth              1.4000 0.0800 -0.5000      NA #> simsurv            1.3930 0.0824 -0.4772  0.0162 #> simpexp, by = 1    1.2582 0.1166 -0.4597  0.0161 #> simpexp, by = 0.25 1.3487 0.0905 -0.5039  0.0163 #> simpexp, by = 0.05 1.3898 0.0835 -0.4914  0.0162 B <- 10; n <- 4000 cuts <- seq(0, 10, by = 0.02) est <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {   set.seed(2000 + b)   dat <- data.frame(id = 1:n, x = rnorm(n))   ss  <- simsurv(dist = "weibull", lambdas = lambda, gammas = gamma,                  betas = c(x = beta_x), x = dat, maxt = 10)   ss  <- merge(ss, dat, by = "id")   sp  <- sim_pexp(~ log_h(t, x), dat, cut = cuts)   c(simsurv = coef(coxph(Surv(eventtime, status) ~ x, ss)),     simpexp = coef(coxph(Surv(tstop, status) ~ x, sp))) }, numeric(2)) data.frame(source = c("simsurv", "simpexp"), estimate = rowMeans(est),   mc_se = apply(est, 1, sd) / sqrt(B), truth = beta_x, row.names = NULL) #>    source   estimate       mc_se truth #> 1 simsurv -0.4987259 0.005103460  -0.5 #> 2 simpexp -0.5056871 0.005156509  -0.5

One draws latent failure time per cause cause-specific hazard keeps minimum; – one simpexp uses – draws waiting time -cause hazard cause probabilities hj(t)/∑khk(t)h_j(t)/\sum_k h_k(t). independent latent times two give cause-specific hazards, must produce data. piecewise constant hazards, exact probabilities available, can checked calculation rather another sample. subject covariate xx: P(cause j)=∑intervals lhjl∑khkl(e−H(κl−1)−e−H(κl)),P(\text{cause } j) \;=\; \sum_{\text{intervals } l} \frac{h_{jl}}{\sum_k h_{kl}}   \Bigl( e^{-H(\kappa_{l-1})} - e^{-H(\kappa_l)} \Bigr), HH -cause cumulative hazard. three agree within Monte-Carlo error share sample size (0.0022). holds cause-specific regression coefficients, fitted one model samples:
code: cut   <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12) r_rel <- c(0.10, 0.22, 0.18, 0.12, 0.08, 0.05) r_dth <- c(0.04, 0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 0.10, 0.12) b_rel <- 0.5; b_dth <- -0.3 dt    <- diff(cut)  n <- 50000 set.seed(7); dat <- data.frame(id = 1:n, x = rnorm(n))  # exact probabilities, for this very covariate vector exact <- rowMeans(vapply(dat$x, function(xi) {   a <- r_rel * exp(b_rel * xi); b <- r_dth * exp(b_dth * xi)   ra <- a + b; H <- c(0, cumsum(ra * dt))   p  <- exp(-head(H, -1)) - exp(-H[-1])   c(cens = exp(-H[length(H)]), relapse = sum(a / ra * p), death = sum(b / ra * p)) }, numeric(3)))  # simpexp: all-cause hazard, then the cause sp <- sim_pexp_cr(list(relapse = ~ log(r_rel[interval]) + b_rel * x,                        death   = ~ log(r_dth[interval]) + b_dth * x),                   dat, cut = cut) sp_share <- prop.table(table(ifelse(sp$status == 0L, "cens", as.character(sp$to))))  # latent failure times: one piecewise exponential time per cause, minimum wins one <- function(rates, bb) vapply(dat$x, function(xi)   msm::rpexp(1, c(rates, rates[length(rates)]) * exp(bb * xi), cut), 0) t1 <- one(r_rel, b_rel); t2 <- one(r_dth, b_dth) tt <- pmin(t1, t2, 12) lat_share <- prop.table(table(   ifelse(tt == 12, "cens", ifelse(t1 < t2, "relapse", "death"))))  round(rbind(exact = exact,             simpexp = sp_share[names(exact)],             latent  = lat_share[names(exact)]), 4) #>           cens relapse  death #> exact   0.0900  0.5659 0.3441 #> simpexp 0.0881  0.5643 0.3475 #> latent  0.0899  0.5650 0.3452 cs_cox <- function(time, cause, x)   c(relapse = coef(coxph(Surv(time, cause == "relapse") ~ x)),     death   = coef(coxph(Surv(time, cause == "death") ~ x)))  B <- 10; n <- 3000 est <- lapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {   set.seed(500 + b)   dat <- data.frame(id = 1:n, x = rnorm(n))   sp <- sim_pexp_cr(list(relapse = ~ log(r_rel[interval]) + b_rel * x,                          death   = ~ log(r_dth[interval]) + b_dth * x),                     dat, cut = cut)   one <- function(rates, bb) vapply(dat$x, function(xi)     msm::rpexp(1, c(rates, rates[length(rates)]) * exp(bb * xi), cut), 0)   t1 <- one(r_rel, b_rel); t2 <- one(r_dth, b_dth); tt <- pmin(t1, t2, 12)   rbind(     simpexp = cs_cox(sp$tstop, ifelse(sp$status == 0L, "cens", as.character(sp$to)), sp$x),     latent  = cs_cox(tt, ifelse(tt == 12, "cens", ifelse(t1 < t2, "relapse", "death")), dat$x)) }) arr <- simplify2array(est)                     # simulator x coefficient x rep m   <- apply(arr, 1:2, mean) se  <- apply(arr, 1:2, sd) / sqrt(B) colnames(m) <- colnames(se) <- c("relapse", "death") round(rbind(truth = c(relapse = b_rel, death = b_dth), m,             `mc se (simpexp)` = se["simpexp", ],             `mc se (latent)`  = se["latent", ]), 4) #>                 relapse   death #> truth            0.5000 -0.3000 #> simpexp          0.4970 -0.3086 #> latent           0.4827 -0.2890 #> mc se (simpexp)  0.0048  0.0091 #> mc se (latent)   0.0112  0.0095

title: Validation against other simulators
text: comparison can made direct way imaginable: simulate time-homogeneous illness-death process recovery, msm::sim.msm() simpexp, fit msm model exact transition times data sets compare estimated intensity matrices. transition counts match well (one replication; diagonal holds censored observations, whose state unchanged last observation time):
code: q <- rbind(c(0, 0.35, 0.05), c(0.50, 0, 0.12), c(0, 0, 0)) states <- c("healthy", "ill", "dead") dimnames(q) <- list(states, states) maxt <- 10; n <- 1500 set.seed(11)  panel_from_msm <- function(n) {   d <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {     s <- msm::sim.msm(q, maxtime = maxt)     data.frame(id = i, time = s$times, state = s$states)   }))   d }  panel_from_simpexp <- function(n) {   s <- sim_pexp_msm(list(     transition("healthy", "ill",     ~ log(0.35)),     transition("healthy", "dead",    ~ log(0.05)),     transition("ill",     "healthy", ~ log(0.50)),     transition("ill",     "dead",    ~ log(0.12))),     data.frame(id = seq_len(n)), cut = c(0, maxt))   first <- s[s$episode == 1L, c("id", "tstart", "from")]   moved <- s[s$status == 1L,  c("id", "tstop", "to")]   stuck <- s[s$status == 0L,  c("id", "tstop", "from")]   # censored: state unchanged   names(first) <- names(moved) <- names(stuck) <- c("id", "time", "state")   d <- rbind(first, moved, stuck)   d$state <- match(as.character(d$state), states)   d[order(d$id, d$time), ] }  fit_msm <- function(d) {   m <- msm::msm(state ~ time, subject = id, data = d, qmatrix = q,                 exacttimes = TRUE, control = list(fnscale = 4000))   qq <- msm::qmatrix.msm(m, ci = "none")   c(`healthy->ill` = qq[1, 2], `healthy->dead` = qq[1, 3],     `ill->healthy` = qq[2, 1], `ill->dead` = qq[2, 3]) }  B <- 5 est <- lapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {   set.seed(300 + b)   rbind(`msm::sim.msm` = fit_msm(panel_from_msm(n)),         simpexp        = fit_msm(panel_from_simpexp(n))) }) arr <- simplify2array(est) m   <- apply(arr, 1:2, mean); se <- apply(arr, 1:2, sd) / sqrt(B) round(rbind(truth = c(0.35, 0.05, 0.50, 0.12), m,             `mc se (msm)`     = se["msm::sim.msm", ],             `mc se (simpexp)` = se["simpexp", ]), 4) #>                 healthy->ill healthy->dead ill->healthy ill->dead #> truth                 0.3500        0.0500       0.5000    0.1200 #> msm::sim.msm          0.3474        0.0497       0.5099    0.1235 #> simpexp               0.3548        0.0492       0.5038    0.1197 #> mc se (msm)           0.0020        0.0008       0.0084    0.0029 #> mc se (simpexp)       0.0034        0.0012       0.0034    0.0021 set.seed(301) list(`msm::sim.msm` = msm::statetable.msm(state, id, panel_from_msm(n)),      simpexp        = msm::statetable.msm(state, id, panel_from_simpexp(n))) #> $`msm::sim.msm` #>     to #> from    1    2    3 #>    1  446 2519  364 #>    2 1829  273  417 #>  #> $simpexp #>     to #> from    1    2    3 #>    1  428 2553  353 #>    2 1834  273  446

title: Validation against other simulators
text: gems builds multi-state process latent transition times clock-reset scale: possible transition current state draws sojourn time parametric distribution takes minimum. makes independent check semi-Markov case. process progressive illness-death model – gems stores one entry time per state therefore represent recurrence, recovery left . sojourn time ill death Weibull shape 1.6, simpexp written Weibull hazard t_sojourn. One analysis applied : occurrence/exposure rates two exits healthy, Weibull model sojourn time ill. simulators reproduce exponential exit rates healthy Weibull sojourn distribution ill, within Monte-Carlo error.
code: library(gems) sh <- 1.6; sc <- 6; r_hi <- 0.35; r_hd <- 0.05 maxt <- 10; n <- 4000  run_gems <- function(n, seed) {   set.seed(seed)   hf <- generateHazardMatrix(3)   hf[[1, 2]] <- "Exponential"; hf[[1, 3]] <- "Exponential"; hf[[2, 3]] <- "Weibull"   pm <- generateParameterMatrix(hf)   pm[[1, 2]] <- list(r_hi); pm[[1, 3]] <- list(r_hd); pm[[2, 3]] <- list(sh, sc)   suppressMessages(     g <- simulateCohort(transitionFunctions = hf, parameters = pm,                         cohortSize = n, to = maxt))   tt <- as.data.frame(g@time.to.state)   data.frame(id = seq_len(n), t_ill = tt[[2]], t_dead = tt[[3]]) }  run_simpexp <- function(n, seed, by = 0.02) {   set.seed(seed)   s <- sim_pexp_msm(list(     transition("healthy", "ill",  ~ log(r_hi)),     transition("healthy", "dead", ~ log(r_hd)),     transition("ill",     "dead", ~ log(sh / sc) + (sh - 1) * log(t_sojourn / sc))),     data.frame(id = seq_len(n)), cut = seq(0, maxt, by = by))   ill  <- s[s$from == "healthy" & !is.na(s$to) & s$to == "ill", ]   dead <- s[!is.na(s$to) & s$to == "dead", ]   data.frame(id = seq_len(n),     t_ill  = ill$tstop[match(seq_len(n), ill$id)],     t_dead = dead$tstop[match(seq_len(n), dead$id)]) } analyse <- function(d) {   d$t_ill[!is.na(d$t_ill) & d$t_ill > maxt]     <- NA   d$t_dead[!is.na(d$t_dead) & d$t_dead > maxt]  <- NA   exit  <- pmin(ifelse(is.na(d$t_ill),  Inf, d$t_ill),                 ifelse(is.na(d$t_dead), Inf, d$t_dead), maxt)   n_ill <- sum(!is.na(d$t_ill))   n_dth <- sum(!is.na(d$t_dead) & (is.na(d$t_ill) | d$t_dead < d$t_ill))   ill   <- d[!is.na(d$t_ill), ]   soj   <- pmin(ifelse(is.na(ill$t_dead), maxt, ill$t_dead), maxt) - ill$t_ill   ev    <- as.integer(!is.na(ill$t_dead) & ill$t_dead <= maxt)   k     <- soj > 0   m     <- survreg(Surv(soj[k], ev[k]) ~ 1, dist = "weibull")   c(`healthy->ill` = n_ill / sum(exit), `healthy->dead` = n_dth / sum(exit),     `sojourn shape` = 1 / m$scale,     `sojourn scale` = exp(coef(m)[["(Intercept)"]])) }  B <- 10 G <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(b) analyse(run_gems(n, 100 + b)), numeric(4)) S <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(b) analyse(run_simpexp(n, 100 + b)), numeric(4)) round(rbind(truth = c(r_hi, r_hd, sh, sc),             gems = rowMeans(G), simpexp = rowMeans(S),             `mc se (gems)` = apply(G, 1, sd) / sqrt(B),             `mc se (simpexp)` = apply(S, 1, sd) / sqrt(B)), 4) #>                 healthy->ill healthy->dead sojourn shape sojourn scale #> truth                 0.3500        0.0500        1.6000        6.0000 #> gems                  0.3498        0.0481        1.6109        6.0021 #> simpexp               0.3516        0.0489        1.6122        6.0142 #> mc se (gems)          0.0023        0.0006        0.0130        0.0242 #> mc se (simpexp)       0.0026        0.0005        0.0095        0.0150
